seoDescription: A design and development studio for growing businesses. We design and build websites, apps and the systems behind them.
title: About the studio
headline: We're the strategy and technology partner behind your business.
lede: From the first idea to the systems you rely on every day, we stay with you as your business grows.
servicesTitle: What we build for growing businesses
servicesLede: The brand and the website, the software your team runs, apps for iPhone and Android, and the reminders and reports that update on their own.
startedBody: A lot of growing businesses run on the same setup. A website someone built a few years ago. Bookings in a spreadsheet or a notebook. Customers in WhatsApp. Payments in a separate app. It works until the business grows, and then the owner spends their evenings holding it all together.
workP1: Fixing that properly used to mean hiring an agency built for much larger companies. We started The Creative Branders so growing businesses could get the same standard of work at a size and price that fits them: the website, the apps and the systems behind them, planned together.
workP2: One person leads your project from the first call to launch. If it needs a mobile developer, a payments specialist or a data analyst, we bring in people we've worked with before. Everything we do shows up in our client portal, so you always know what's been done and what's next.
factsNote: Numbers matter – but the stories behind them matter even more:
valueClarityBody: We explain things plainly and agree scope and cost in writing before work starts.
valueCareBody: We build every project as if we'll maintain it for years, because we usually do.
valueOwnershipBody: If something goes wrong, we fix it and tell you exactly what happened.
valueResponsibilityBody: We protect your customers' data and only use tools we'd trust with our own.
